title: Grok Aurora Prompt Output Schema
description: Validation schema for prompt generation output targeting Grok Aurora (grok-imagine-image). Supports text-to-image, single-image editing, and multi-image editing modes.

generation_mode.description: Which generation mode this prompt targets

prompt.description: Natural language prompt. 2-5 sentences recommended. May include inline negative guidance ('avoid: ...'). No special syntax, flags, or JSON — plain English only.

negative_guidance.description: Optional inline exclusion list. Included at the end of the prompt or as a separate field for tracking. Format: 'avoid: cartoon, anime, distorted features'.

model.description: Model identifier — always grok-imagine-image for Aurora

aspect_ratio.description: Output aspect ratio. 'auto' lets the model choose based on prompt content.

n.description: Number of images to generate per request. UI default is 4.

seed.description: Seed value for reproducibility (Aurora --s parameter). Same seed + same prompt = visually consistent results. Null for random. NOTE: In Aurora this is a SEED, not a style reference (changed from Flux era).

response_format.description: How the image is returned. URLs are temporary.

url.description: Image URL or base64 data URI

purpose.description: How this reference image is used in the generation

reference_images.description: Reference images for editing modes. Single edit: 1 image via image_url. Multi-edit: up to 3 images via image_urls.

directors_notes.description: Human-readable explanation of prompt decisions for director review
